questions.explanation: A browser request needs name resolution to find an address, routing to reach it, transport to deliver bytes reliably and security negotiation to protect them. A failure at any lower stage appears as an application that cannot load content. Diagnosing such problems means walking the stack in order rather than assuming the symptom's layer is the faulty one. The concrete addresses in the case do not change the rule.
questions.hint: Ask what the application needs from each layer below it.
questions.learningObjective: identify and explain protocol interaction using a packet-level scenario

Each layer is completely independent, so an address error cannot affect an application.
